headline: Google has released Gemini 3.8 Live, a voice model meant to carry out tasks such as drafting emails while the user keeps talking.
score_reason: Pool score kept: notable consumer voice-assistant upgrade, but performance figures are unverified claims from one regional outlet.
importance_line: Voice users, including people who speak local dialects, may get an assistant that does office tasks hands-free, but the speed and memory gains are reported figures, not independent tests.
summary: Bhaskar English reports that Google has introduced Gemini 3.8 Live and a Live Extended Thinking version, which can use tools in the background to finish tasks, such as drafting a Gmail reply, while a person speaks. It says the model supports about 97 languages, cuts response delay by 20% and doubles how much of a conversation it remembers compared with older models.
notes: Headline mentions India launch; body gives no India-specific details. Figures are as reported.
